reply_text:
Moss's 30 September strategic digest lists it as support ticket **#8841**. It says Mateo Quiroga submitted it for Vantorre Group. Drivers on the second shift at Newark couldn't select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. The digest also says you escalated it to the platform engineering queue.

Check the number before you send it to engineering. On 1 July you told #strategic-pod you had closed "ticket #8841" with support, and that one was about the Detention Summary CSV export and a kiosk browser cache problem. The same number may be a mix-up, either in the digest or in that earlier message. I can't see the ticket records themselves, only the digest, so I can't confirm which is right. Look #8841 up in the support system to make sure it's the Door 14 kiosk issue.
